svg.data-crop-note: The chanted word's second atom, which opens line 20; its first atom ends line 19, so no one rectangle holds the whole chanted word.
svg.data-regions-by: Claude (Opus 5.5), 2026-11-01: a draft that a script of Claude's made from the stroke-SVG's strokes. Each sample of the ink, at 3 samples a pixel, took the groups of the strokes covering it, or else of the nearest strokes within 12 pixels; a part of one label smaller than 4 pixels joined its neighbour; a cut was traced along each boundary between two labels, simplified to within half a pixel; and each piece of ink the cuts leave took its seed at its deepest sample and the groups of most of its samples. The groups' ids, kinds, owners and notes, and the supplied ink's reasons, are the stroke-SVG's, and an id sN in them names one of its strokes. Ben drew the cut c11 on 2026-11-01, in place of the draft's cuts c7, c8 and c9 and its region rg6, which was in both the pe's group and the nun's. Claude drew the cut c12 and the region rg15 from Ben's words of the same day, so that the qamats's dot is a region of its own beside its bar.

path.data-note: Ben's, drawn on 2026-11-01 (statement 62): the pe and the nun do not touch, and a thin strip of vellum, which level 1's fill covers, runs between them

Claude's, from Ben's words of 2026-11-01 (statement 63): the qamats's dot is a region of its own, which touches the bar above it only as a circle touches a tangent; the cut runs along the bar's lower edge

g.data-note: the עליון strand's vowel: the left bar
the תחתון strand's vowel: the right bar and the dot under it
